TRAVEL DESK NOTE — CONNECTION RISK FOR PASSENGER N. ABERNATHY, 25 SEPTEMBER 2026

Itinerary: inbound flight SK 1462 scheduled to arrive at the hub at 14:10; outbound flight SK 2019 scheduled to depart at 15:20. Minimum connection time at the hub: 30 minutes.
Connection rule (from the hub's transfer data): with the outbound on time, the passenger makes the connection if the inbound arrives no more than 40 minutes late. If the outbound departs at least 20 minutes late, the passenger makes it if the inbound arrives no more than 60 minutes late. The outbound never departs early.
Evidence:
- Inbound SK 1462, last 50 operations on this weekday and season: 34 arrived no more than 40 minutes late; 6 arrived between 41 and 60 minutes late; 10 arrived more than 60 minutes late.
- Outbound SK 2019: departs at least 20 minutes late on 25% of days, otherwise on time (within 5 minutes).
- The two flights' delays are independent (different aircraft, crews and origins).
Travel agent's note: "34 out of 50 on-time inbounds — so about a one-in-three chance of misconnecting."

decision.instructions: Will passenger N. Abernathy miss the connection to SK 2019? Give probabilities that reflect the evidence in the state.
